verdict.summary: The change correctly makes the two existing sparq-engine planner features default-on for the native sparq-mcp surface, forwards each feature explicitly, and updates the matching public-surface documentation. The new tests are non-vacuous for the intended integration contract: they pin the manifest default set, make broken feature forwarding fail compilation by referencing feature-gated engine APIs, exercise algebra rewriting through the real MCP tools/call query path, compare DP-planned and explicitly disabled planner results on that path, and check scoped planner state restoration. The literal-equality decline witness covers the stated sq-lr2ii boundary. No security issue, soundness regression, hostile instruction, heavy dependency addition, or uncaveated privacy claim appears in the diff.
